definitions.explanation: With the top and bottom positions reversed.
In the opposite order or direction.

examples.english: The picture is hanging upside down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{逆様|さかさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いた。
examples.english: I was holding the book upside down.

examples.japanese: ⟦カップ→カップ：01077_kappu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{逆様|さかさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧して⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧。
examples.english: I dry the cup by turning it upside down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逆様|さかさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧なった。
⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧{逆様|さかさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{履|は}いて→履く：00700_haku⟧いた。
examples.english: I was wearing my shoes on the wrong feet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逆様|さかさま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧しまった。
examples.english: The order of the story was reversed, and I stated the conclusion first.

notes:
{逆様|さかさま} describes something being upside down, inverted, or in reverse order. It functions as a na-adjective and is often used adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

KANJI:
More commonly written in kana as さかさま or ⟦{逆|さか}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧さま. The kanji {逆様|さかさま} is less frequent.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: ⟦{逆|さか}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧さまな⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (an upside-down state)
- Adverbial: ⟦{逆|さか}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold upside down)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{逆|さか}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn upside down
- ⟦{逆|さか}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become upside down/reversed
- ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦{逆|さか}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧さま: left and right reversed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧: reverse, opposite (more abstract/general)
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧: opposite (direction, opinion)
- ⟦{裏返|うらがえ}→裏返す：07508_uragaesu⟧し: inside out, turned over
